title: READABLE HIT REACTIONS WARDROBE
description: The change is pitched as onboarding, but it quietly rewires what the team thinks a beginner is worth. Enemies now stagger, flash, and fall with timing that makes successful hits feel less like clerical work. Outfits now include prestige variants, matching effects, and a bundle preview that understands insecurity.
consequence: The combat log finally stopped doing all the emotional labor. Self-expression gained tiers, timers, and a receipt.

title: READABLE HIT REACTIONS COOLDOWN
description: The update makes the game easier to explain from the outside, with consequences for those still inside. Enemies now stagger, flash, and fall with timing that makes successful hits feel less like clerical work. Limited-time labels and countdown nudges have been softened across the event shop.
consequence: The combat log finally stopped doing all the emotional labor. Players felt less hunted. The dashboard noticed immediately.

title: GROUNDED TRAVERSAL PASS WARDROBE
description: The change softens one part of the product while sharpening another part that can be measured. Jumping, mounting, and rolling now preserve more momentum debt so movement feels heavier and more authored. Outfits now include prestige variants, matching effects, and a bundle preview that understands insecurity.
consequence: The character moves like they read the physics spec and took it personally. Self-expression gained tiers, timers, and a receipt.
